==Purpose of template==

Link to calendar pages.

==How to use==

{| class="wikitable"
| Example input
| Output
|-
| <nowiki>{{ne}}</nowiki>
|         {{ne}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{ne|998}}</nowiki>
|         {{ne|998}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{ne|998|Choren}}</nowiki>
|         {{ne|998|Choren}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{ne|998|Choren|17}}</nowiki>
|         {{ne|998|Choren|17}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{ne|Choren}}</nowiki>
|         {{ne|Choren}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{ne|998|17}}</nowiki>
|         {{ne|998|17}}
|-
|}
